style.name: Constructivism
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick #5: Constructivism / 构成主义风格. Build nine distinct premium editorial scenes with dynamic red-black geometry, urgent diagonals, bold photomontage, industrial machinery, angular sans-serif typography, rough paper and ink texture, and a restrained palette of crimson, black, warm ivory and steel grey. Translate every modern news subject into a different spatial narrative rather than repeating a template, generic sphere, three number cards or dashboard. Content, evidence, diagrams and story scenes occupy at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10-15% at edges or the bottom. Reduce information density by about 20%, emphasize one conclusion and no more than three key facts in 3-5 large readable modules, and keep text on calm low-texture fields with generous spacing. NO.01 is the exception: preserve all eight numbered one-sentence summaries exactly around a central constructivist world-machine or radiating globe, using sweeping diagonals, circular tracks, layered photomontage and naturally staggered quiet text fields rather than a rigid eight-cell grid, table, equal cards, dense borders or tiny type. Each overview sentence must remain complete, with clear 1-8 order and no extra event. Chinese and English keep the same composition, scene, hierarchy and rhythm. Use only the labels 虾子曰： and 豆豆龙： or Xiazi Says: and Doudoulong:. Put the exact text xiazishuo.com legibly in the bottom safe area of every poster. Every raw image must be native 1:2 portrait, every final image exactly 887x1774, with natural undistorted faces, circles, type and characters, and artwork filling all four edges with zero non-design white strips, pillarbox, letterbox or scaling gaps.

zh-CN.intro:
1. 联合国裁军研究所启动军事AI治理新行动，警告AI正挤压预警、侦察和核相关决策中的人类判断空间。
2. BasinCheck由一名创始人运营，以离线安全检查和OSHA记录服务工业承包商，验证MRR 895美元、5个活跃订阅。
3. Rezi把AI写作、关键词匹配和ATS评分落到求职流程，Stripe验证MRR 245643美元、10191个活跃订阅。
4. PadelPROShop从西班牙向欧洲扩张，年收入由250万欧元增至2026年预计2600万欧元，Shop应用订单同比增长284%。
5. UNEP确认无或有限超调守住1.5°C的机会已经消失，若要本世纪末回到阈值，2030年前全球排放需下降18%。
6. 法国报告全球首例Shamonda病毒人类感染，患者严重免疫低下且已去世，但当局目前未发现普通人群公共卫生风险。
7. UNODC与IOM估算2025年约19万至20.9万人经四条主要海路被偷渡入欧，支付费用合计3.88亿至5.09亿美元。
8. Nature研究显示蝴蝶翅纹与振翅共同制造虚假运动线索，使捕食者误判速度和方向。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 今天的共同信号，是技术、商业与自然系统都在提醒我们：真实机制比醒目表象更重要。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把收入证据、风险边界和实验条件一起看，才不会被单一数字带走。

en-US.headlineView: Military AI, solo compliance, AI careers, cross-border padel, the climate gap, a new virus, sea smuggling and butterfly vision enter one action map
en-US.headlineFull: October 23 Global Operator Radar; Military AI, solo compliance, AI careers, cross-border padel, the climate gap, a new virus, sea smuggling and butterfly vision enter one action map
en-US.intro:
1. UNIDIR launched new military-AI governance work while warning that AI is crowding human judgment out of early warning, reconnaissance and nuclear-related decisions.
2. One founder runs BasinCheck for industrial contractors with offline safety inspections and OSHA records, at $895 verified MRR and five active subscriptions.
3. Rezi applies AI writing, keyword matching and ATS scoring to job-search workflows, with $245,643 Stripe-verified MRR and 10,191 active subscriptions.
4. Spain's PadelPROShop expanded across Europe as annual revenue rose from EUR2.5 million to an expected EUR26 million in 2026 and Shop app orders grew 284% year on year.
5. UNEP says the chance of holding 1.5°C with no or limited overshoot is gone, and returning by century-end requires global emissions to fall 18% by 2030.
6. France reported the first documented human Shamonda-virus infection; the severely immunocompromised patient died, but authorities currently see no public-health risk to the general population.
7. UNODC and IOM estimate 190,000 to 209,000 people were smuggled on four main sea routes to Europe in 2025, paying $388 million to $509 million in fees.
8. Nature research shows that butterfly wing patterns and flapping create false motion cues that make predators misjudge speed and direction.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Today's shared signal is that technology, business and natural systems all make real mechanisms more important than striking appearances.
en-US.doudouQuote: Revenue evidence, risk boundaries and experimental conditions belong beside every headline number.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 联合国把军事AI的人类控制推入常设治理
zh-CN.headlineView: 预警、情报、侦察与核相关流程正在压缩判断时间，新行动将政府、企业和研究者拉进同一套责任框架
zh-CN.headlineFull: 联合国把军事AI的人类控制推入常设治理；预警、情报、侦察与核相关流程正在压缩判断时间，新行动将政府、企业和研究者拉进同一套责任框架
zh-CN.intro: 联合国裁军研究所10月20日说明，其AI、和平与安全卓越中心将启动多项新行动，覆盖自主武器、非国家行为体滥用，以及AI与核、网络技术的交汇。研究所负责人警告，AI已进入预警、情报分析、侦察和信息收集，人类判断空间正被逐步挤压。中心获得包括五个核武器国家在内的广泛资助，初始计划可支持五年，并将与防务科技公司、软件开发者、投资者、政府和民间社会讨论负责任的行业行为。当前成果仍是自愿治理与研究平台，不等同于具有强制力的国际条约；关键检验是能否把可预测性、国际法合规和保留人类控制转化为可审计的设计与部署规则。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 军事AI最危险的不是单次错误，而是决策链太快，让人类只剩批准按钮。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 有论坛和资金是起点，真正的门槛是可验证的停机、追责和人工否决。

en-US.headlineFact: The UN moves human control of military AI into standing governance
en-US.headlineView: Early warning, intelligence, reconnaissance and nuclear-related workflows are compressing decision time, bringing governments, industry and researchers into one responsibility framework
en-US.headlineFull: The UN moves human control of military AI into standing governance; Early warning, intelligence, reconnaissance and nuclear-related workflows are compressing decision time, bringing governments, industry and researchers into one responsibility framework
en-US.intro: On October 20, the UN Institute for Disarmament Research described new initiatives from its Centre of Excellence on AI, Peace and Security covering autonomous weapons, misuse by non-state groups, and convergence with nuclear and cyber technologies. Its director warned that AI is already entering early warning, intelligence analysis, reconnaissance and information gathering, progressively crowding out human judgment. The centre has broad donor support including all five nuclear-weapon states and initial funding for five years, and it plans consultations with defence-technology companies, software developers, investors, governments and civil society on responsible industry conduct. The output is still voluntary governance and research, not a binding treaty; the real test is whether predictability, international-law compliance and retained human control become auditable design and deployment rules.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Military AI's deepest risk is not one error but a decision chain so fast that humans become approval buttons.
en-US.doudouQuote: A forum and funding are a start; verifiable shutdowns, accountability and human veto remain the gate.

zh-CN.headlineView: 5个订阅就支撑早期收入：把油气承包商的纸质安全检查、整改闭环和OSHA记录做成离线移动工作流
zh-CN.headlineFull: BasinCheck一人运营，验证MRR 895美元；5个订阅就支撑早期收入：把油气承包商的纸质安全检查、整改闭环和OSHA记录做成离线移动工作流
zh-CN.intro: BasinCheck由创始人Jacob Szyszka运营，面向美国油气、施工和其他受OSHA监管的20至300人承包商，把检查表、照片、签名、整改任务和OSHA 300/300A记录放进可离线使用的移动产品。TrustMRR在10月19日显示其验证MRR为895美元、5个活跃订阅、累计收入5576美元；这意味着少量B2B客户就能形成真实现金流。当前定价为每月149、299和599美元，全部包含无限用户，按每月现场记录量分层，并以7天试用、免费JSA与许可证工具、行业协会参与和创始人直接销售触达获客。杠杆来自窄行业、高客单和软件交付，限制则是客户数少、收入波动大、合规责任高，且入门协助、支持与定制仍可能占用创始人时间。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司不必先追一万用户，五个愿意为高风险流程付费的客户已经能验证方向。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 高客单带来杠杆，也把续费、支持和合规信誉集中在一个人身上。

en-US.headlineView: Five subscriptions support early revenue by turning oilfield contractors' paper safety checks, corrective actions and OSHA records into an offline mobile workflow
en-US.headlineFull: Solo-run BasinCheck reaches $895 verified MRR; Five subscriptions support early revenue by turning oilfield contractors' paper safety checks, corrective actions and OSHA records into an offline mobile workflow
en-US.intro: Founder Jacob Szyszka runs BasinCheck for U.S. oil-and-gas, construction and other OSHA-regulated contractors with roughly 20 to 300 workers, combining checklists, photos, signatures, corrective actions and OSHA 300/300A records in an offline-capable mobile product. TrustMRR showed $895 verified MRR, five active subscriptions and $5,576 all-time revenue on October 19, so a handful of B2B customers already produces real cash flow. Current plans are $149, $299 and $599 a month with unlimited users and usage tiers based on monthly field records; acquisition includes a seven-day trial, free JSA and permit tools, industry-association participation and founder-led outreach. The leverage comes from a narrow niche, high contract value and software delivery. The limits are equally clear: few customers make revenue lumpy, compliance trust is demanding, and onboarding, support and custom work can still consume the founder's time.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A one-person company does not need 10,000 users first; five buyers paying for a high-risk workflow can validate the direction.
en-US.doudouQuote: High contract value creates leverage while concentrating renewal, support and compliance trust on one person.

zh-CN.headlineView: AI写简历不是聊天演示：围绕ATS关键词、评分、定制和面试练习，叠加订阅、终身买断与机构授权
zh-CN.headlineFull: Rezi验证MRR 245643美元；AI写简历不是聊天演示：围绕ATS关键词、评分、定制和面试练习，叠加订阅、终身买断与机构授权
zh-CN.intro: Rezi把生成式AI嵌入求职者愿意付费的完整任务：写和改简历要点、根据职位描述补关键词、进行ATS评分、生成求职信，并提供面试练习和人工简历复核。TrustMRR衍生的公开验证卡显示，Rezi目前Stripe验证MRR为245643美元、10191个活跃订阅，30天增长为负6.1%；另一渠道快照显示累计收入已超过1000万美元。个人免费版承担获客，Pro版每月29美元、终身版149美元，另有面向大学、机构和职业服务商的企业方案。公开分发分析把SEO与模板页视为主要渠道，同时还有终身优惠、联盟和机构合作。可核验收入证明AI确实落到付费结果，但负增长、就业需求周期、低转换成本和通用模型竞争仍是现实风险。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 赚钱的AI应用常常不是发明新需求，而是把已有高意图流程做得更快、更可信。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 24.6万美元MRR很真实，负增长也同样真实；成熟产品更要看留存和分发成本。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：赚钱的AI应用落地。

en-US.headlineView: AI resume writing is more than a chat demo when it combines ATS keywords, scoring, tailoring and interview practice with subscriptions, lifetime access and institutional licensing
en-US.headlineFull: Rezi reaches $245,643 verified MRR; AI resume writing is more than a chat demo when it combines ATS keywords, scoring, tailoring and interview practice with subscriptions, lifetime access and institutional licensing
en-US.intro: Rezi embeds generative AI into a complete job-seeker workflow people pay for: writing and editing resume bullets, matching job-description keywords, ATS scoring, cover letters, interview practice and optional human review. A public card derived from TrustMRR currently shows $245,643 in Stripe-verified MRR, 10,191 active subscriptions and negative 6.1% growth over 30 days; another distribution snapshot puts all-time revenue above $10 million. A free tier acquires users, Pro costs $29 a month, Lifetime costs $149 once, and enterprise plans serve universities, agencies and career platforms. Public channel analysis identifies SEO and templated pages as the leading distribution engine, supplemented by lifetime deals, affiliates and institutions. Verified revenue proves AI has converted into payment, while negative growth, job-market cycles, low switching costs and competition from general models remain material risks.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Profitable AI often does not invent demand; it makes an existing high-intent workflow faster and more trustworthy.
en-US.doudouQuote: $245,643 MRR is real, and so is negative growth; mature products still live or die on retention and distribution cost.

zh-CN.headlineFact: PadelPROShop年收入预计从250万增至2600万欧元
zh-CN.headlineView: 西班牙板式网球零售商用本地支付、单仓欧洲配送、Shop应用和国家队赞助，把增长做进结账与履约
zh-CN.headlineFull: PadelPROShop年收入预计从250万增至2600万欧元；西班牙板式网球零售商用本地支付、单仓欧洲配送、Shop应用和国家队赞助，把增长做进结账与履约
zh-CN.intro: PadelPROShop销售球拍、球、握把和装备，目标市场从西班牙扩展到德国、意大利、法国、英国及更多欧洲国家。Shopify案例披露，其首个完整年度收入为250万欧元，之后依次达到500万、900万、1600万和2000万欧元，2026年预计2600万欧元；过去一年Shop应用订单增长284%。赚钱机制不是单一爆款，而是品牌授权商品、本地支付与一键结账、B2C和B2B库存同步，以及Shop Campaigns、Meta广告、约20家合作俱乐部和西班牙、阿根廷国家队赞助共同获客。公司从3人扩到约50人，并计划依托现有仓库与UPS实现欧洲重点市场24小时配送。主要风险是平台交易费、单仓和物流伙伴依赖、库存压力，以及高速扩张下的服务稳定性。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境赚钱不是翻译页面，而是让支付、库存、履约和品牌触点一起适配市场。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 收入增长十倍很强，但50人团队、单仓和物流费都会把规模变成新的约束。

en-US.headlineFact: PadelPROShop expects annual revenue to rise from EUR2.5M to EUR26M
en-US.headlineView: The Spanish padel retailer turns local payments, one-warehouse European delivery, the Shop app and national-team sponsorship into checkout and fulfilment growth
en-US.headlineFull: PadelPROShop expects annual revenue to rise from EUR2.5M to EUR26M; The Spanish padel retailer turns local payments, one-warehouse European delivery, the Shop app and national-team sponsorship into checkout and fulfilment growth
en-US.intro: PadelPROShop sells rackets, balls, grips and gear, expanding from Spain into Germany, Italy, France, the UK and wider European markets. Shopify's case study says revenue moved from EUR2.5 million in its first full year to EUR5 million, EUR9 million, EUR16 million and EUR20 million, with EUR26 million expected in 2026; Shop app orders grew 284% over the past year. The profit engine is broader than one hit product: authorized brands, local payments and one-click checkout, synchronized B2C and B2B inventory, Shop Campaigns, Meta ads, roughly 20 partner clubs, and sponsorship of the Spanish and Argentine national teams all support acquisition. The company scaled from three people to about 50 and aims for 24-hour delivery across key European markets through its current warehouse and UPS. Risks include platform transaction fees, dependence on one warehouse and logistics partner, inventory pressure, and service stability during rapid growth.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border profit is not a translated page; payments, inventory, fulfilment and brand touchpoints must adapt together.
en-US.doudouQuote: Tenfold revenue growth is powerful, but a 50-person team, one warehouse and logistics fees turn scale into a new constraint.

sources.title: How PadelPROShop grew revenue more than 10 times

zh-CN.headlineFact: UNEP确认1.5°C无超调路径已经失去
zh-CN.headlineView: 若要本世纪末回到1.5°C，全球排放需在2030、2035和2040年前分别下降18%、45%和69%
zh-CN.headlineFull: UNEP确认1.5°C无超调路径已经失去；若要本世纪末回到1.5°C，全球排放需在2030、2035和2040年前分别下降18%、45%和69%
zh-CN.intro: 联合国环境署10月21日发布《2026排放差距报告：回归点》，认为在不超调或仅有限超调下把升温控制在1.5°C的机会已经消失。最低超调情景要求本世纪中叶峰值约为1.7至1.8°C，并依靠持续减排和二氧化碳移除在2100年前回到1.5°C。对应路径需要以2025年为基准，到2030、2035和2040年分别减排18%、45%和69%；2035年前可再生电力容量还需增加到三倍，煤炭占比下降一半以上。按当前政策，世纪末升温约2.8°C；即使所有国家承诺兑现仍约2.6°C。报告同时警告，约3200亿吨二氧化碳移除需求昂贵且未被规模验证，不能替代直接减排。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 1.5°C从避免超调变成争取回归，代价不是口号，而是每一年更陡的减排曲线。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 碳移除是补充，不是把今天的排放账单推给未来技术。

en-US.headlineFact: UNEP says the no-overshoot path to 1.5°C is gone
en-US.headlineView: Returning by century-end requires global emissions to fall 18%, 45% and 69% by 2030, 2035 and 2040
en-US.headlineFull: UNEP says the no-overshoot path to 1.5°C is gone; Returning by century-end requires global emissions to fall 18%, 45% and 69% by 2030, 2035 and 2040
en-US.intro: The UN Environment Programme released Emissions Gap Report 2026: The Point of Return on October 21, concluding that the chance of holding warming to 1.5°C with no or limited overshoot is gone. Its lowest-overshoot scenario peaks around 1.7-1.8°C near mid-century, then relies on sustained cuts and carbon-dioxide removal to return to 1.5°C by 2100. Against 2025 levels, the pathway requires emissions reductions of 18% by 2030, 45% by 2035 and 69% by 2040; renewable electricity capacity must triple by 2035 and coal's share must fall by more than half. Current policies point to about 2.8°C of warming, while fully delivered national commitments still imply about 2.6°C. The report also cautions that removing roughly 320 gigatonnes of carbon dioxide would be expensive and unproven at scale, so it cannot substitute for direct cuts.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The 1.5°C task has shifted from avoiding overshoot to fighting for a return, with a steeper emissions curve every year of delay.
en-US.doudouQuote: Carbon removal is a supplement, not a way to send today's emissions bill to future technology.

sources.title: As temperatures spike, this new report outlines humanity's options for containing climate change

zh-CN.headlineFact: 法国确认全球首例Shamonda病毒人类感染
zh-CN.headlineView: 病例发生在严重免疫低下患者，疑由蠓虫叮咬感染；调查仍在继续，目前没有普通人群风险信号
zh-CN.headlineFull: 法国确认全球首例Shamonda病毒人类感染；病例发生在严重免疫低下患者，疑由蠓虫叮咬感染；调查仍在继续，目前没有普通人群风险信号
zh-CN.intro: 法国卫生机构10月22日报告，里昂一名因严重疾病接受治疗且免疫功能严重受损的患者感染Shamonda病毒，并于10月初去世。这是该病毒首次被记录在人类身上；它此前主要经Culicoides属叮咬蠓在牛等动物间传播，1960年代在尼日利亚首次发现，2026年夏季首次在欧洲牲畜中检出。现阶段推测患者在法国东部被叮咬后感染，临床、病毒学和流行病学调查仍在进行，是否以及多大程度导致死亡仍需确认。ECDC正与法国、欧盟伙伴和动物卫生机构协作监测。当前只有一个高度特殊病例，官方明确表示尚未发现对普通人群的公共卫生风险，不能据此推断已具有人际传播能力。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 首例人类感染值得严肃监测，但严肃不等于放大：病例条件与传播证据必须分开。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 现在已知的是一个免疫低下患者的异常病例，不是普通人群疫情。

en-US.headlineFact: France confirms the first documented human Shamonda-virus infection
en-US.headlineView: The case involved a severely immunocompromised patient and likely a biting midge; investigation continues with no current risk signal for the general population
en-US.headlineFull: France confirms the first documented human Shamonda-virus infection; The case involved a severely immunocompromised patient and likely a biting midge; investigation continues with no current risk signal for the general population
en-US.intro: French health authorities reported on October 22 that a patient in Lyon receiving treatment for a serious illness and living with severe immunosuppression had been infected with Shamonda virus and died in early October. It is the first documented human infection. The virus had previously circulated mainly among cattle and other animals through Culicoides biting midges, was first detected in Nigeria in the 1960s, and appeared in European farm animals for the first time in summer 2026. Investigators currently suspect a bite in eastern France, while clinical, virological and epidemiological work continues to determine whether and how much the infection contributed to death. ECDC is coordinating with French, European and animal-health partners. With one highly exceptional case, authorities say there is currently no identified public-health risk to the general population and no basis to infer human-to-human spread.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A first human infection deserves serious surveillance, but seriousness is not amplification: case conditions and transmission evidence must stay separate.
en-US.doudouQuote: What is known is one exceptional case in an immunocompromised patient, not a general-population outbreak.

sources.title: Severely ill patient in France becomes first ever human infected with Shamonda virus
sources.publisher: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control

sources.title: Virus Shamonda: une première détection chez l'être humain

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧洲海路偷渡费一年达到3.88亿至5.09亿美元
zh-CN.headlineView: 约19万至20.9万人经四条主要海路被偷渡，中央地中海最繁忙，价格差异暴露出成熟的跨境犯罪市场
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧洲海路偷渡费一年达到3.88亿至5.09亿美元；约19万至20.9万人经四条主要海路被偷渡，中央地中海最繁忙，价格差异暴露出成熟的跨境犯罪市场
zh-CN.intro: UNODC与IOM的新估算显示，2025年约19万至20.9万人经四条主要海路被偷渡至欧洲，向组织者支付的费用合计3.88亿至5.09亿美元。中央地中海路线最繁忙，估计有8.4万至10.04万人；东地中海其次，约4.84万至5.13万人。费用因路线和风险显著分化：西北非大西洋路线最低可约170美元，而从北非或土耳其前往意大利、马耳他的受访者中，近一半支付超过7500美元。这个规模说明偷渡不是零散临时行为，而是能跨地区定价、转移路线并依赖中介网络的犯罪市场。执法若只压缩单一路线，可能把人流推向更长、更危险的路径；合法通道、金融追踪和跨境调查需要同步推进。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 把偷渡看成一门数亿美元的生意，才能理解它为何会不断换路线而不是自动消失。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 费用越高不代表越安全，很多人付的是风险溢价，却没有到达保证。

en-US.headlineFact: Sea-smuggling fees into Europe reached $388M-$509M in one year
en-US.headlineView: An estimated 190,000-209,000 people used four main sea routes, with the Central Mediterranean busiest and wide price gaps revealing a mature transnational criminal market
en-US.headlineFull: Sea-smuggling fees into Europe reached $388M-$509M in one year; An estimated 190,000-209,000 people used four main sea routes, with the Central Mediterranean busiest and wide price gaps revealing a mature transnational criminal market
en-US.intro: New UNODC and IOM estimates indicate that 190,000 to 209,000 people were smuggled to Europe across four major sea routes in 2025, paying organizers a combined $388 million to $509 million. The Central Mediterranean was the busiest corridor with an estimated 84,000 to 100,400 people, followed by the Eastern Mediterranean with roughly 48,400 to 51,300. Prices varied sharply by route and risk: passage on the Northwest African Atlantic route could cost as little as $170, while nearly half of surveyed travelers heading from North Africa or Türkiye to Italy or Malta paid more than $7,500. The scale shows a criminal market capable of cross-border pricing, route substitution and intermediary networks rather than isolated facilitation. Enforcement focused on one corridor can displace people toward longer and deadlier journeys, so legal pathways, financial tracing and international investigations must move together.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Seeing smuggling as a half-billion-dollar business explains why it changes routes instead of simply disappearing.
en-US.doudouQuote: A higher fee does not guarantee safety; many people pay a risk premium with no promise of arrival.

sources.title: Migrants paid up to $500 million in smuggling fees on European sea routes
Smuggling of migrants: the harsh search for a better life
sources.publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime

zh-CN.headlineFact: 蝴蝶翅纹会制造虚假的运动方向
zh-CN.headlineView: 高速摄影、397个欧洲物种、计算演化和3000次人类捕捉实验共同显示，图案与振翅能让攻击落在错误位置
zh-CN.headlineFull: 蝴蝶翅纹会制造虚假的运动方向；高速摄影、397个欧洲物种、计算演化和3000次人类捕捉实验共同显示，图案与振翅能让攻击落在错误位置
zh-CN.intro: Nature发表的研究提出，蝴蝶翅纹不只用于伪装或警戒，还会与振翅节奏共同制造“运动炫惑”。团队以每秒1000帧拍摄起飞，用鸟类视觉模型比较真实轨迹与图案产生的运动信号；天然翅纹比去除图案后的版本带来更强的前后和侧向混淆。随后，研究者模拟397个欧洲物种的757种形态，并让算法演化57500多种图案，得到与自然蝴蝶相似的高对比条带。100名参与者完成3000次触屏捕捉实验时，高混淆图案让攻击点更偏后或偏侧。结果说明鲜明翅纹可能是移动动物中极有效的防御策略，也为机器人外观、动态标识和视觉感知系统提供仿生线索。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的伪装不一定让你看不见，也可能让你看见了却判断错方向。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 漂亮图案并非静态装饰；一旦与运动结合，它就变成了实时干扰信号。

en-US.headlineFact: Butterfly wings create false directions of motion
en-US.headlineView: High-speed video, 397 European species, digital evolution and 3,000 human capture trials show that pattern plus flapping can move attacks to the wrong place
en-US.headlineFull: Butterfly wings create false directions of motion; High-speed video, 397 European species, digital evolution and 3,000 human capture trials show that pattern plus flapping can move attacks to the wrong place
en-US.intro: Research published in Nature proposes that butterfly wing patterns do more than camouflage or signal: combined with wingbeats, they create motion dazzle. The team filmed take-offs at 1,000 frames per second and used a bird-vision model to compare real trajectories with motion signals generated by patterning; natural wings produced stronger forward-backward and sideways confusion than experimentally unpatterned versions. Researchers then simulated 757 morphotypes across 397 European species and digitally evolved more than 57,500 patterns, converging on high-contrast bands similar to real butterflies. In 3,000 touchscreen capture trials involving 100 participants, high-confusion designs shifted attacks backward or sideways. The findings suggest that vivid wings may be one of the most effective moving-animal defences and offer bio-inspired clues for robot surfaces, dynamic signage and visual-perception systems.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Effective camouflage need not make you invisible; it can let you be seen while making direction impossible to judge.
en-US.doudouQuote: A beautiful pattern is not static decoration; paired with motion, it becomes a live interference signal.

sources.title: From butterflies to wagon wheels: how pattern and movement influences motion detection and behaviour
